$comment: Licence policy for scripts/check-licenses.mjs. See docs/licensing.md. A package fails the check when its declared licence expression is strong copyleft (GPL, AGPL, CC-BY-SA...), non-commercial or unknown, unless it has an exception here. Weak copyleft (LGPL, MPL) is allowed but listed. `overrides` correct package metadata that is missing or wrong; every override cites the page it was verified on. `exceptions` accept a risk and must say why it does not reach users.

overrides.name: dotenv
overrides.evidence: https://pypi.org/pypi/dotenv/0.9.9/json (a shim that only depends on python-dotenv; repository pedroburon/dotenv carries an MIT LICENSE). PyPI metadata says UNKNOWN.

overrides.name: stop-sequencer
overrides.evidence: https://github.com/hyunwoongko/stop-sequencer README states Apache-2.0; the repository has no LICENSE file and the sdist has no licence metadata, so this is UNVERIFIED as a formal grant. Benchmark-only, not shipped.

overrides.name: pypdfium2
overrides.evidence: https://github.com/pypdfium2-team/pypdfium2 (README, Licensing: Apache-2.0 or BSD-3-Clause, with the PDFium binary and its BUILD_LICENSES). PyPI metadata lists 'BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, dependency licenses', which is not a valid expression.

overrides.name: langdetect
overrides.evidence: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mimino666/langdetect/master/NOTICE and LICENSE are Apache-2.0; setup.py says MIT, the classifier says Apache.

exceptions.name: html2text
exceptions.reason: GPL-3.0-or-later (https://pypi.org/pypi/html2text/2025.4.15/json). Pulled in by bfcl-eval for the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard run. Benchmark tooling that runs on a developer machine; it is never imported by, bundled with or distributed alongside the application or its sidecars.
